Select molecule ChEMBL ID, name, maximum phase, type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL3603819. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return molecule_chembl_id, pref_name as molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
